articles.summary: At Wealthfront, the “tech” in financial technology isn’t just a buzzword—it’s the foundation of everything we build. Beneath the intuitive frontend our clients interact with lies a complex ecosystem of distributed systems. One of the most critical pieces of that backend architecture is the engine that enables us to route massive volumes of trades efficiently. ... Read more
articles.title: Putting the Tech in Fintech: How We Use FIX to Execute Trades at Scale
